hero.subheadline: Innovation within the global Life Sciences ecosystem requires a profound synthesis of materials engineering, molecular biology, pharmacology, and market dynamics. The primary objective is to transform complex scientific discoveries into concrete clinical and industrial solutions.
hero.subheadline2: Moving beyond the traditional academic paradigm, an executive and translational approach to science takes shape: an ecosystem where research seamlessly evolves into advanced therapies, intellectual property, and new entrepreneurial ventures. The commitment focuses on overcoming contemporary medical challenges—from the development of smart nanotechnologies to regenerative medicine, through the proactive management of aging—with the intent of generating a tangible and lasting impact on the quality of human health.

bio.title: Biography
bio.p1: The union of unparalleled academic rigor with a strong market-oriented vision defines the career of Prof. Ennio Tasciotti. His journey, rooted in the educational excellence of the Scuola Normale Superiore of Pisa in Italy, was consolidated in the United States through the direction of departments and the establishment of cutting-edge research centers at the Houston Methodist Hospital.
bio.p2: The scientific and executive leadership exercised in these environments enabled the creation and management of multidisciplinary ecosystems, supported by significant institutional and government investments aimed at advancing personalized medicine, nanotechnology, and regenerative therapies. Having returned to Italy to direct the Human Longevity Program at IRCCS San Raffaele and assume the role of Full Professor, the global impact of his vision continues to be recognized by the most prestigious international academic rankings and top-tier scientific honors, cementing his status as a pioneer in the Life Sciences.

macroAreas.title: Drug Delivery
macroAreas.subtitle: Nanomedicine and Targeted Transport
macroAreas.body: The development of proprietary platforms has made it possible to bypass key biological barriers, actively de-risking oncology, inflammatory, and neurological therapies. The innovation introduced by the Multi-Stage Vector (MSV) defined new horizons for controlled release systems. Subsequently, the creation of Leukosomes (biomimetic vectors coated with leukocyte membranes) enabled the evasion of the immune system, promoting active accumulation in pathological sites. The latest evolutions include vectors derived from neuronal membranes (Neurosomes and Astrosomes), designed to deliver advanced therapies directly into the Central Nervous System.

macroAreas.body: Pivoting away from traditional inert prosthetics, research has driven the development of 3D biomimetic scaffolds capable of addressing unmet needs in the orthopedics, trauma, and cardiology sectors. The engineering of polymer matrices enriched with porous silicon particles acts as an intelligent biological support, designed to instruct endogenous repair processes in critical tissue defects, with the goal of radically improving surgical and rehabilitative outcomes.

macroAreas.title: Immune and Stem Cell Biology
macroAreas.subtitle: Immunomodulation
macroAreas.body: The synergistic interaction between biomaterials and the immune system represents a fundamental asset for resolving systemic inflammation. Studies have demonstrated that materials can be engineered to orchestrate cellular behavior in vivo. In particular, by modulating macrophage polarization from a pro-inflammatory to a pro-regenerative phenotype, it is possible to promote potent tissue angiogenesis and actively prevent the failure of implantable medical devices.

macroAreas.title: Longevity and Healthspan Engineering
macroAreas.subtitle: 4P Medicine
macroAreas.body: To address the global gap between life expectancy and functional health, research integrates the 4P Medicine paradigm (Predictive, Preventive, Personalized, Participatory). This pipeline aims to mitigate the clinical and economic burden linked to modifiable lifestyle factors, with an emphasis on combating neurodegeneration induced by inflammaging and environmental stress. Within this sphere lie scientific directions aimed at deploying nanotherapeutics for the prevention and treatment of cognitive decline.

longevity.title: The Science of Longevity
longevity.subtitle: Engineering Healthspan to compress morbidity and optimize functional health.
longevity.metaDesc: Engineering Healthspan to compress morbidity and optimize functional health through longevity medicine.
longevity.introText1: The extension of chronological life expectancy has generated a systemic gap relative to longevity lived in full functional health. The majority of global healthcare costs are now attributable to modifiable behavioral determinants, often defined by the "4S" (Sedentary lifestyle, dietary choices, chronic Stress, excess). The Human Longevity Program at IRCCS San Raffaele promotes the application of 4P Medicine (Predictive, Preventive, Personalized, Participatory) to transform aging into a proactively manageable process, optimizing biological resilience at the cellular level.
longevity.stat1Lbl: The average gap to be bridged between chronological life expectancy and functional health.
longevity.stat2Lbl: Of global healthcare spending generated by modifiable lifestyle factors.
longevity.stat3Lbl: The clinical paradigm applied by the Human Longevity Program at IRCCS San Raffaele: a Predictive, Preventive, Personalized, and Participatory science.
longevity.social1Text: The 2026 epidemiological data are clear: we have extended lifespan, but biological quality lags behind by nearly 13 years. 80% of the clinical burden and global healthcare costs are driven by modifiable behavioral factors. Longevity medicine is not cosmetic anti-aging; it is the engineering of cellular resilience to compress morbidity and preserve autonomy. Here are the numbers driving our research.
longevity.pillarsSubtitle: Regulating the molecular and cellular mechanisms of aging through three systemic levers.
longevity.pillar1Body: Combating inflammaging (chronic silent systemic inflammation) by optimizing food biochemistry. Nutrients act as vectors of epigenetic information, capable of modulating gene expression and protecting the delicate gut-brain axis.
longevity.pillar2Body: Activating muscle tissue not just for its biomechanical function, but as a true endocrine organ. The release of myokines induced by movement stimulates mitochondrial biogenesis and activates the lymphatic drainage of cellular toxins.
longevity.pillar3Body: Chronic stress and social isolation profoundly alter the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis, accelerating aging. The introduction of practices linked to "hormetic stress" and the protection of interpersonal relationships foster DNA repair, supporting healthy and balanced brain aging.
longevity.social2Text: Precision movement and nutrition are not simple habits; they are integrated biological pharmacology. By studying macrophage polarization (the cellular switch from M1 to M2) and controlling tissue myokines, our research demonstrates that aging can be reprogrammed directly in vivo. The Pillars of Longevity explained through laboratory evidence.
longevity.evidenceTitle: From Academic Validation to Translational Clinic
longevity.evidenceSubtitle: Milestones and protocols of Prof. Ennio Tasciotti in targeting senescence and inflammaging.
longevity.evidenceBio: Solutions targeting cellular senescence and combating neurodegeneration (such as Alzheimer's disease) represent the most advanced clinical frontier. Through the development of anti-inflammatory nanotherapeutics and the modulation of the immune environment, research aims to safeguard the integrity of the brain, recognized as the central element in ensuring not only the duration, but above all the quality and meaning of human existence.

longevity.social3Text: The science of longevity has real value only when founded on rigorous and traceable clinical evidence. From our landmark works in Nature Nanotechnology and Nature Materials on overcoming biological cellular barriers, to the recent 1 million Euro PNRR funding for using nanotherapeutics against inflammaging and neurodegeneration in Alzheimer's disease, our goal remains constant: protecting Healthspan. The biology of aging explained through facts and scientific validation.

divulgazione.title: Science Communication
divulgazione.body: Rigorous scientific research finds its ultimate expression when made accessible. Prof. Tasciotti's communication activities promote a paradigm shift: the transition from a reactive, symptom-oriented medical model to a holistic, proactive, and biomimetic science of health. Through the use of clear narratives and impactful metaphors, the complex dynamics related to nanotechnologies, aging, and the development of medical devices become understandable concepts for society as a whole.

tedx.title: Major TEDx Stages (Vision & Innovation)
tedx.body: Participation in numerous internationally renowned TEDx events has helped define the technological vision and market trends for medical innovation, addressing crucial themes: from the intercellular communication of biomimetic nanovectors to the ethics of technological innovation, through to practical strategies for actively experiencing biological aging.

tv.title: Institutional & Mainstream Television Presence
tv.body: Academic authority has been consolidated through ongoing collaboration with top-tier media formats. From cutting-edge documentaries on nanotechnology and bio-hybrid materials alongside Piero Angela on Rai 1 (Superquark), to exploring the frontiers of translational medicine in prime-time journalistic investigations (Presa Diretta on Rai 3). His presence extends to national networks and international all-news channels, offering essential guidance in the public debate on how to combat inflammaging, manage delicate metabolic transitions such as menopause (Real Time), and understand the critical impact of lifestyles on biological age.

Through rigorous due diligence activities, the necessary technological de-risking is guaranteed to optimize the development of new advanced therapies and medical devices.
